name: Glen Ridge Summer Day Camp
description_short: Outdoor borough day camp based at Carteret Park for Glen Ridge residents ages 5 to 12, with sports games, crafts, board games, water games and bus trips. Families sign up by the day, up to 40 campers a day.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds for changed plans; the daily fee is refunded only for rained out days or extenuating family circumstances. Days cannot be switched or transferred.
notes: Glen Ridge residents only; campers must be 5 before January 1, 2027. Monday to Friday 9 am to 3 pm (times vary on trip days; see the camp calendar). $50 per day, online registration only. 10 counselors, a mix of certified teachers and students 16 and older. Campers bring lunch and a water bottle; refrigeration available.
